# A directory is one package: a declaration in one of its files may name one in
# any other, and each file keeps its own imports.
#
# Neither held. The checker checked an imported directory one document at a
# time and merged the results, so `struct Calc { op Op }` reported Op as an
# unknown type when Op was in the file next to it; and the CLI's merge dropped
# every sibling's imports, so a file could only use what the file it was merged
# into had imported.

# Cross-file: the program names a type, a const, a func and a component that
# the imported package declares across four files.
sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o out app.sngl
grep 'LIMIT is 7' out/index.html
grep 'twice: 14' out/index.html
grep 'Badge' out/index.html

# An alias stays the file's own. `parts.sngl` imports sngl:ui/draw as `draw`;
# `types.sngl` does not, and naming draw.canvas there is an error.
! sngl check leak/
stderr 'unknown component "draw.canvas"'

# Two files importing the same package get the same declarations, not two
# copies: type identity is per-declaration, so a second check of the package
# would make `Op` and `Op` different types at the call site where they meet.
sngl check twice/

# A relative import is relative to the file that wrote it, not to the program.
sngl check nested/

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "./pkg"

component main {
    vbox {
        text(value="LIMIT is {pkg.LIMIT}")
        text(value="twice: {pkg.twice(pkg.LIMIT)}")
        pkg.Badge(label="Badge")
    }
}
-- pkg/types.sngl --
enum Op { none, add }

struct Pair {
    x int = 0
    op Op = Op.add
}
-- pkg/consts.sngl --
const LIMIT = 7
-- pkg/funcs.sngl --
func twice(n int) => n * 2

// Names a type from types.sngl and a const from consts.sngl.
func widened(p Pair) => p.x + LIMIT
-- pkg/views.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component Badge(label = "") {
    text(value=label)
}
-- leak/app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "./gfx"

component main {
    gfx.Panel
}
-- leak/gfx/parts.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

component Panel {
    draw.canvas(width=10px, height=10px) {
        draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=10.0, h=10.0, style=draw.CanvasStyle{fill=#000000})
    }
}
-- leak/gfx/types.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component Sneaky {
    draw.canvas(width=10px, height=10px) {}
}
-- twice/app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "./shared"
import "./user"

component main {
    var op shared.Op = shared.Op.add
    text(value=user.describe(op))
}
-- twice/shared/shared.sngl --
enum Op { none, add }
-- twice/user/user.sngl --
import "../shared"

func describe(o shared.Op) => o == shared.Op.add ? "add" : "none"
-- nested/app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import "./outer"

component main {
    text(value=outer.label())
}
-- nested/outer/outer.sngl --
import "../inner"

func label() => inner.NAME
-- nested/inner/inner.sngl --
const NAME = "inner"
